## What user problem does this change solve?
Describe the current flow, the desired behavior and why a simpler alternative would not work.

## Visual and functional quality
- [ ] Reviewed existing app behavior, regression risks and repo `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] Used `docs/APP_DESIGN_QUALITY.md`; design references are named and accessible (no assumed Mobbin/Figma connection)
- [ ] Clear primary action, consistent navigation, typography, spacing, contrast, readable buttons and accessible labels
- [ ] Checked keyboard, system bars/insets, small phones, tablet, landscape and font scaling where relevant
- [ ] Added correct loading, empty, failed request, permission, progress and recovery states
- [ ] No nonfunctional buttons, unnecessary feature complexity, surprise autoplay or unconfirmed success messages

## Reliability / privacy
- [ ] No regression to existing workflows, settings, local storage, update/signing continuity or app identity
- [ ] Secrets and personal information remain protected; irreversible actions require confirmation
- [ ] Verified behavior with relevant tests, lint and build checks
